offering_description.value: Underwrites specialty commercial insurance for businesses with hard-to-place risks that standard insurers often decline. Sells policies through brokers and managing general agents, and earns premiums and investment income on the funds it holds.

primary_products.value: excess and surplus lines casualty insurance; commercial property insurance; professional liability insurance; specialty liability insurance

customer_segment.value: B2B: businesses with specialty or hard-to-place risks, and the brokers and agents placing their coverage

end_markets.value: construction; real estate; transportation; manufacturing; professional services

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: insurance premiums paid by policyholders, plus investment income on reserves

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: takes in premiums from insured businesses via brokers and pays their claims

geography_served.value: US national: businesses across all US states through surplus lines and admitted insurance

specialization.value: related lines: casualty, property, professional and other specialty insurance lines sharing the same brokers and underwriting

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: wholesale and retail insurance brokers placing business with the company; partners / resellers: managing general agents and program administrators that underwrite on its behalf

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance licensing and rate and form approval by state insurance regulators, plus surplus lines rules

notes: Exact product line mix and business shares may have changed; treat line details as approximate.
